podcast.title: Joining Arcade Fire
podcast.body: Tim Kingsbury, from Guelph, Ontario, joined Arcade Fire as part of a new lineup that formed after the band's initial difficulties, alongside William Butler and Richard Reed Perry. "baby brother William Butler was drafted along with Tim Kingsbury of Guelph Ontario"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Joining Arcade Fire
xref.body: William Butler was "drafted" into Arcade Fire following an onstage implosion during a debut EP performance, joining a new lineup that also included Tim Kingsbury and Richard Reed Perry. "But then, baby brother William Butler was drafted along with Tim Kingsbury of Guelph Ontario"

xref.title: Joining Arcade Fire
xref.body: Richard Reed Perry, described as a multi-instrumentalist, grunge fan, and vegetarian cook from Ottawa, joined Arcade Fire as part of the new lineup after the band's initial difficulties, alongside William Butler and Tim Kingsbury. "this new lineup, which also included a multi-instrumentalist grunge fan and vegetarian cook from Ottawa named Richard Reed Perry"
